name: Perfect Reload
notes: Reloading (even without this orb mod) will show an 'effect' that lasts the reload time amount. when it expires your reload completes. This orb adds to that effect a UI element that is a golden pie slice, the equivalent of 0.2s/total reload time of the volume of the circle. i.e. if the reload time is 1 secon, the pie slice is 1/5th the size of the circle. if you tap reload a second time when the reload effect has decayed to that section of the reload, it triggers a "perfect" reload that gives the bonus ammo and ends the reload animation, refilling your gun(s) faster than a normal reload would. the pie slice always appears between the second half of the reload, in a random spot each time.
summary: While reloading, if reload is tapped a second time, timed perfectly within the golden window of the reload, it grants a extra bullets overloading the magazine and finishing the reload early.
